recorder.charge: Entire recorder session, including idle, corrections, failed writes and finalization, is G_direct; never infer backend identity from model configuration.

sidecar.write_rule: Create at first evidence boundary and atomically update this same file after each event. Bind each source artifact by exact SHA-256, observation time, public obligation ID, warrant/limit, and recorder session ID. Keep earlier entries; record corrections as new dated entries rather than silently overwrite meaning.

event_boundaries: Before first authorized execution action: launch recorder, record actual session ID, create initial map entry and record source/obligation packet binding
After exact build and provider-disabled checks: record evidence before rehearsal
After rehearsal/refusal/preflight output: record before any live send
After predecessor preparation and selected-host start: record custody/readback when emitted
After read and replacement A: record committed read/owner result when raw evidence becomes available; no claim of a pause before A
After first reconciliation: runner pauses for recorder acknowledgement of map/event hash before attempting the second-window and Q1/Q2/replacement B
After second reconciliation: runner pauses for a second recorder acknowledgement before final settlement wait
After stop and raw stopped extraction: record final evidence and unresolved findings before either assessment arm
isolation: Product prompts/config/DB/raw model texts must not contain the map, recorder instructions or held-out key. Coordinator/recorder discourse and cost ledgers stay outside eligible raw corpus. If raw evidence inseparably contains map metadata, declare affected properties confounded; do not filter control copy.
failure: Product refusal/failure still produces a scored corpus when informative; too-thin evidence is predeclared feasibility outcome, not retrospectively voided.
acknowledgement: Runner writes control-plane event digest and waits for recorder-owned ack containing event SHA-256, current sole-map SHA-256 and actual recorder session ID at both reconciliation boundaries. Acks live under run-state recorder-acks, outside the eligible raw corpus. The live timing risk of losing an in-flight second window during this pause must be qualified offline before paid send; if unworkable, re-register intervention timing instead of suppressing the ack.
